PRESET NOTES:

  • If you use any of the force / override options in the Bot Settings that affect the preset, the preset will receive those changes ON DISK if you enable all of the bot settings, then go to the preset editor - change a value and then save.
  • You do not need to do this, but if you want the changes on disk for your preset instead of in memory, you need to do this.
  • This includes things like Force Stock, Override Muzzle Chances, Allow T7, Normalize Scav Equipment, etc
  • KEEP THIS IS MIND IF YOU PLAN ON SHARING YOUR PRESET AS AN APBS ADDON

Major Release + BugFix
